text_elements.text: LI-ION BATTERY HEATER RELAY UNIT : Disassembly and Assembly
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: DANGER: Since hybrid vehicles and electric vehicles contain a high voltage battery, there is the risk of electric shock, electric leakage, or similar accidents if the high voltage component and vehicle are handled incorrectly. Be sure to follow the correct work procedures when performing inspection and maintenance.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: WARNING:
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Be sure to remove the service plug in order to disconnect the high voltage circuits before performing inspection or maintenance of high voltage system harnesses and parts.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To prevent the removed service plug from being connected by mistake during the procedure, always carry it in your pocket or put it in the tool box.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to wear insulating protective equipment consisting of glove, shoes, face shield and glasses before beginning work on the high voltage system.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Refer to EVB-6, "High Voltage Precautions".
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To prevent electric shock hazards, ignition, and damage to parts, always remove Li-ion battery controller before disassembling battery pack.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: CAUTION: There is the possibility of a malfunction occurring if the vehicle is changed to READY status while the service plug is removed. Therefore do not change the vehicle to READY status unless instructed to do so in the Service Manual.
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: WORK ENVIRONMENT FOR DISASSEMBLY OF LI-ION BATTERY
text_elements.label: section_header

text_elements.text: Must be an indoor environment.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The work environment must be able to be isolated from the outside by shutters or other means to prevent the intrusion of rain, snow, sand, and other substances.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The environment must prevent the entry of sweat during work, and also prevent condensation from occurring as a result of high temperature and humidity.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: No entry of foreign materials.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: In  addition  to  being  indoors,  the  environment  must  not  permit  the  entry  during  disassembly  work  of metal powders, oil, or foreign substances resulting from causes such as servicing of other vehicles.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: If there is any risk of the above, use a plastic curtain or other means to block off the work area, or take other necessary steps.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The floor must be dry.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: The floor must not become wet as a result of causes such as vehicles entering when it is raining or snowing.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Work space
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Space approximately the size of one vehicle must be secured as the disassembly space.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: A sign indicating that disassembly is in progress or other measures must be taken so that persons other than the workers do not enter the work space.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Standard fire fighting equipment
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Always place a standard fire fighting equipment in the disassembly work area.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Depending  on  type  of  fire  (vehicle  or  battery)  use  standard  fire  fighting  equipment  (water  or  extinguisher).
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove the following; Refer to EVB-219, "BATTERY JUNCTION BOX AND BATTERY HARNESS : Disassembly and Assembly".
text_elements.label: list_item
